label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness) is TP because the insecure randomness source 'new java.util.Random().nextLong()' is used to generate 'rememberMeKey', which is then used as a session identifier in a cookie. Alert 2 (java/xss) is TP because the user-provided value from the cookie 'BenchmarkTest00086' is directly concatenated into the HTTP response without sanitization, creating an XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: Insecure randomness source 'new java.util.Random().nextLong()' used to generate 'rememberMeKey'
